@triton.jit
def rejection_greedy_sample_kernel(
    output_token_ids_ptr,
    bonus_token_ids_ptr,
    draft_token_ids_ptr,
    target_argmax_ptr,
    mask_ptr,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
):
    """Triton kernel for greedy rejection sampling."""
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    offset = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    mask = tl.load(mask_ptr + offset)

    # 主采样逻辑
    draft_token_id = tl.load(draft_token_ids_ptr + offset)
    target_argmax_id = tl.load(target_argmax_ptr + pid)
    accepted_mask = (draft_token_id == target_argmax_id) & mask

    # ... 采样处理 ...

    # 调用封装的 bonus_renew 算子
    bonus_renew(output_token_ids_ptr, bonus_token_ids_ptr,
                offset, accepted_mask, BLOCK_SIZE)


@triton.jit
def bonus_renew(output_token_ids_ptr, bonus_token_ids_ptr,
                offset, accepted_mask, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):
    # 缺少注释说明为何封装为独立方法
    bonus_token_id = tl.load(bonus_token_ids_ptr + offset,
                             mask=accepted_mask)
    tl.store(output_token_ids_ptr + offset * 2 + 1,
             bonus_token_id, mask=accepted_mask)
